name: Grant Gustin Over Grave
look: A behind-the-scenes photo on a grassy film set. Actor Grant Gustin, in a dark coat and tie, crouches beside a plain white headstone and a fresh mound of dirt, smiling and flashing a peace sign. A crowd in dark coats stands behind him.
use: The grave is labeled with something that has died, ended or gone out of style, and the grinning man is whoever is glad it's gone or helped finish it off.
slots: label on the headstone: what died or ended
label on the smiling man: who is happy about it
examples: Everyone who had to use it
describe: guy smiling and doing a peace sign next to a grave
man posing happily beside a fresh grave and headstone
the flash actor kneeling by a tombstone grinning
smiling dude at a funeral throwing up a peace sign
happy guy crouching over a dirt grave at a cemetery
origin: A behind-the-scenes photo of Grant Gustin, star of The Flash, posing beside a prop grave on a film set.
